Subject: Private/VPC demo request - ACME Health (regulated workloads)

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for a trial yesterday and we're evaluating Redwood for a private/VPC deployment to support our regulated workloads (HIPAA-bound patient data). I'd love to set up a demo focused on Private deployments, network requirements, and the onboarding process.

Attendees from our side will likely include myself (Director, IT), one of our Engineers (cc'd to follow), and our Security lead if available. We're in Pacific Time. These windows work for us this week: Wed 5/13 10-12 or Thu 5/14 14-16. If neither works we can propose next week.

Can you confirm availability and whether this demo can include a technical deep-dive (network/firewall, KMS integration, audit logs)? Also, do you have a standard agenda and network checklist we can review beforehand?

Thanks,
Elaine Byrne
Director of IT
ACME Health

Hi Elaine — thanks for signing up and for the note. Happy to coordinate.

Short answer: yes, we can run a Private/VPC (on-prem-like) demo with a technical deep-dive and bring our Sales Engineer to cover network/KMS/audit logs. Vivek (cc) will lead the SE portion.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 5/13 10:30-11:15
- Thu 5/14 14:00-14:45

If neither works, share a few alternative slots and we’ll re-run.

I've attached a short demo agenda so you know what we cover. For the technical session we typically cover: architecture overview, network requirements, KMS/HSM options, data flow & audit logging, deployment options (VPC, on-prem bundle), and a Q&A.

Would you like us to cover SOC 2 / compliance artifacts in the session or send them in advance? We can bring a high-level compliance pack and follow up with more detail after the call.

I'll wait to hear which slot you prefer and will send a calendar invite once confirmed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
